headline: Oil Prices Fell Sharply During the Week
summary: Oil prices fell sharply during the week. OPEC+ ministers will hold a series of meetings on November 29 to set production policy for 2027.
why: OPEC+ coordinates output among major oil producers, so its production decisions directly influence global crude prices.
why_moved: Oil fell sharply over the week, and the report links the outlook to OPEC+ ministers' meetings on November 29 that will set 2027 production policy.
original_headline: Precios del petróleo cayeron fuerte durante la semana
